title: Child Support Excluded from the Waiver Income Count — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Desk Guidance
content:
Support the claimant is ordered to pay is excluded from the countable annual income on a Benefit Overpayment Accounts waiver request, as recorded on the Department's withholding records, the claimant's Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders. The amount excluded is taken off the countable annual income.

| Orders on the withholding records | Support excluded |
|---|---|
| An active Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | The order's weekly amount multiplied by 52, the weeks in a year |
| No such order, but an active Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | The deductions taken under the arrears-only order in the income window, multiplied by the annualizing multiplier of 4 |
| Neither order | Nothing |

## How the desk reads the records

- Only orders with status active count.
- When an active current support order is on the records, its weekly amount decides the exclusion, even if an arrears-only order is also active.
- The deductions under an arrears-only order are the deduction entries taken under that order, dated by the date each was taken; the income window is the three whole months before the handling date (whole months from the date taken to the handling date fewer than 3).

## Hypothetical cases

| Records | Support excluded |
|---|---|
| Active current support order, weekly amount USD 80.00 | USD 80.00 times 52, USD 4,160.00 |
| Active arrears-only order only, USD 150.00 deducted under it in the window | USD 150.00 times 4, USD 600.00 |
| A current support order that is suspended, no other order | Nothing |
